title: Compliance Engine Assessor Result
description: Canonical result JSON emitted by `compliance-engine-assessor audit` / `remediate`. This is the Phase 1 shape; per-rule `tags` and inline `metadata` are added when the unified benchmark-definition input lands (Phase 3), which is why additional properties are permitted at the top level and per rule.

osconfigVersion.description: Version of the OSConfig build that produced the result.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the run started.

host.description: Provenance of the scanned host. Benchmark definitions are architecture-agnostic, so the arch/distribution a result was produced on is recorded here for multi-arch traceability.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the run in milliseconds.

status.description: Overall status: NonCompliant if any rule is NonCompliant.

rules.description: One entry per evaluated rule, in evaluation order.

indicators.description: The engine's step-by-step reasoning tree for the rule.

title.description: Human-readable rule title (the ResourceID; reuses the definition's field name).

ruleId.description: Stable, benchmark-agnostic rule identifier (UUID derived from the payload key).

section.description: Externally-quoted per-rule identifier (dotted CIS number or STIG id).

parameters.description: Effective parameters (payload defaults merged with any user overrides).
